## Scope

A sample of 522 graded sets was read again by a second grader as part of the quality audit. The second reading provided a comparison between the original grading and the independent review. This approach was used to assess consistency across the graded sets included in the sample. The review was limited to the sets selected for the audit and does not represent a reassessment of all grading activity.

## Result

Overall agreement was 64.9 per cent. This result summarises the level of agreement between the original grading and the second grader’s assessment. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed with each grader privately to support appropriate review and follow-up.
